prerequisites: The TFG must be defended and evaluated once it is reliably confirmed that the student has passed all other subjects in the study plan and therefore has all the necessary credits to obtain the Degree, except those corresponding to the TFG itself.

learning_outcomes.text: Capacity to integrate all general and specific competencies within the scope of the completed Degree studies.

The specific learning outcomes of the end-of-degree project will vary depending on the assigned theme by the tutor but, as a general rule, they will be directly related to the specific objectives of the degree.

These results will be reflected in the individual completion, presentation, and defense before a university tribunal of an original project in the field of Engineering of a professional nature, in which all acquired competencies are synthesized and integrated.

syllabus_topics: The contents of the End-of-Degree Project carried out by each student individually will be framed within one of the work topics within the area of Engineering in which they have pursued their studies, as indicated in the objectives of each degree program.

assessment_methods.method: Monitoring of the student's in-person activities by their academic tutor
Final document presented by the student
Public presentation of the work before the tribunal and subsequent debate

assessment_rules: The End-of-Degree Project must be presented and defended before a university tribunal. The evaluation will generally consider the monitoring of in-person activities by the tutor, the final document, and the public presentation and debate. The final definition of the evaluation system will comply with the regulations of the School of Engineering. Both ordinary and extraordinary evaluations are conducted through a public presentation before a tribunal of three professors.
